responsibility: Declares the main loop optimizer data structures and public APIs for GCC’s natural-loop subsystem. It defines `loop`, `loop_exit`, iteration-bound and control-IV records, loop-unrolling decisions, loop traversal helpers (`loops_list`), target-specific loop cost parameters, and interfaces for loop optimizer initialization/finalization, register-pressure cost estimation, loop iteration queries, hot-path extraction, and many common loop and nesting utilities that analyses and transformations across GCC consume.
same_name_distinction: Defines the main natural-loop data structures and public APIs, including loop, loop_exit, iteration-bound records, traversal helpers, and target loop-cost state; unlike gcc/cfgloop.cc, it is the subsystem’s declaration header rather than the implementation of core loop operations.
